person.name: Ronaldo Pardieu
person.summary: Cloud-focused IT professional with hands-on experience supporting enterprise systems and building cloud infrastructure using AWS and Terraform. Currently working as a Help Desk Analyst while actively building cloud engineering skills, with the goal of transitioning into a Cloud DevOps engineering role.

experience.title: Help Desk II
highlights: Provides Tier 2 support to 2,600+ users, troubleshooting hardware, software, and Citrix-related issues across multiple sites
Images, deploys, and maintains PCs, laptops, thin clients, and printers, ensuring proper system upgrades and repairs
Administers user accounts and permissions in Active Directory, including password resets and account terminations
Acts as an escalation point for junior staff, providing technical guidance on critical IT issues
Troubleshoots and resolves issues with Citrix-based systems, remote connectivity, and local network issues

experience.title: Cloud Engineer Intern
highlights: Developed reusable Terraform modules to provision cloud resources across multiple environments
Implemented CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions and pre-commit to enforce security and code consistency
Built and tested env0 deployment templates to standardize infrastructure provisioning
Worked in an Agile Scrum environment, tracking progress via Jira stories and sprint reviews
Identified and decommissioned unused cloud resources, reducing costs by approximately $20K annually

experience.title: Software Engineering Fellow
highlights: Selected from a competitive pool of ~200 applicants for a technical fellowship focused on software engineering and professional development
Led operations for a team-based software engineering project, coordinating tasks and deliverables across team members
Strengthened skills in collaboration, Agile methodologies, and full-stack development practices

projects.name: Cloud Resume Challenge
projects.description: Ronaldo's personal portfolio and resume site, built as part of the Cloud Resume Challenge to demonstrate real-world AWS skills beyond certifications. The site is a fully serverless static application: S3 for storage, CloudFront as the CDN, Route 53 for DNS, ACM for the TLS certificate, and AWS WAF in front of CloudFront. Infrastructure is defined in Terraform with remote state in S3 and locking via DynamoDB, and deploys run through GitHub Actions.

projects.name: COVID Reporting Web Application
projects.description: A full-stack MERN application for healthcare professionals to submit and review structured radiology reports for COVID-19 patient exams. Ronaldo led the SWE Operations team, coordinated engineering efforts, designed backend data workflows, and supported frontend development.

projects.name: DevOps Lab
projects.description: A hands-on lab for practicing production DevOps workflows: repeatable infrastructure, automated deployments, and troubleshooting environments. Includes CI/CD pipelines that lint, test, build, and deploy; Terraform-managed infrastructure with remote state; and separate dev/stage/prod environments.

projects.name: Porcupine Open-Source Contributions
projects.description: Open-source contributions to Porcupine, a Python/Tkinter code editor, fixing real GitHub issues: added a Restart action to the File menu, added a safeguard against accidentally closing the app with unsaved tabs open, fixed the Filetypes menu disappearing when a tab is popped into a new window, and implemented folder duplication inside the IDE.

cloud_resume_challenge_general_info: The Cloud Resume Challenge is a well-known hands-on project (created by Forrest Brazeal) where participants build and deploy a personal resume website using real cloud infrastructure, then document the build publicly. It typically involves: a static frontend hosted on cloud storage behind a CDN with a custom domain and HTTPS, a serverless backend (often a visitor counter) using a function-as-a-service and a NoSQL database, infrastructure defined as code, and a CI/CD pipeline that deploys on every commit. It's used as a portfolio piece to demonstrate practical cloud skills to employers.
